summary_en: SBI Holdings subsidiary SBINM LLC corrected withdrawal conditions in its tender offer for BASE Inc. Following FTC clearance on September 4, 2026, the company refined regulatory references to align with revised legal standards, clarifying that certain procedural conditions no longer apply to the offer to acquire BASE shares.
title_en: Notice of Correction regarding Commencement of Tender Offer for BASE Inc. Stock (Securities Code: 4477) and Conclusion of Capital and Business Alliance Agreement
translation_en_brief:
On August 28, 2026, SBI Holdings announced the commencement of a tender offer for all shares of BASE Inc., a company listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange Growth Market, through its subsidiary SBINM LLC. Following receipt of a notification from the Fair Trade Commission on September 4, 2026, stating that no exclusionary measures would be imposed, the bidder submitted a corrected tender offer filing on September 8, 2026.

The correction refined the withdrawal conditions previously disclosed in the initial announcement and tender offer opening notice. Specifically, the company removed references to certain regulatory standards no longer applicable under revised legal interpretation. The modification concerns technical statutory cross-references related to withdrawal conditions (specifically, excluding certain subsections of the Financial Instruments and Exchange Law Enforcement Regulation Article 14). The company explicitly stated this correction does not constitute a change to the purchase price, number of shares sought, tender offer period, or other material terms.
